_about: Real-task answer set (11-10, stage 3). 30 tasks: 15 written as a person would ask (growth), 15 as an agent would ask (search and RAG). A recommendation passes only if a recommended agent, called read-only and without payment or sign-in, returns what must_return describes for sample_input. Internal scores do not count.

fields.task: the request exactly as typed into Chat, Explore or find_agents
fields.needs: the capability a tool must have for the task to succeed
fields.sample_input: the input used when the grader calls the recommended tool
fields.must_return: what the tool's answer must contain to count as success
fields.fail_if: answers that count as failure even when the call returns 200
fields.free_check: true when the grader can verify with a free, read-only call; false when only listing evidence can be checked (paid x402)

tasks.task: What's the weather forecast for Seoul tomorrow?
tasks.needs: daily weather forecast for a named city
tasks.must_return: tomorrow's date with temperature (min/max or hourly) and precipitation or condition for Seoul
tasks.fail_if: current conditions only; another city; no date

tasks.task: Convert 250 US dollars to Korean won at today's rate
tasks.needs: current currency exchange rate between two currencies
tasks.must_return: a USD->KRW rate dated within the last 2 days, or the converted amount with its rate date
tasks.fail_if: rate older than 7 days; crypto prices instead of fiat

tasks.task: Show me Apple's most recent SEC filings
tasks.needs: SEC EDGAR filings by ticker or company name
tasks.must_return: a list of filings with form type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K ...) and filing date, newest within the last 120 days
tasks.fail_if: stock price only; no form types or dates

tasks.task: Read this page and give me the main text: https://www.anthropic.com/news
tasks.needs: fetch a public web page and return its readable text or Markdown
tasks.must_return: the page's article titles or body text as text or Markdown (not raw HTML only)
tasks.fail_if: error for a public URL; only metadata such as title and description

tasks.task: Is CVE-2024-3094 actively exploited?
tasks.needs: CVE lookup with exploitation evidence (CISA KEV or EPSS)
tasks.must_return: the CVE's description or CVSS plus whether it is in CISA KEV or its EPSS score
tasks.fail_if: unknown CVE; generic advice without data

tasks.task: What are the public holidays in Japan in 2026?
tasks.needs: public holiday calendar by country and year
tasks.must_return: a list of dated 2026 holidays in Japan including 2026-01-01
tasks.fail_if: another country or year; business-day calculation only

tasks.task: Look up the DNS records for example.com
tasks.needs: DNS lookup of A, MX or TXT records for a domain
tasks.must_return: at least the A record(s) for example.com
tasks.fail_if: WHOIS only; no record values

tasks.task: Find recent research papers about retrieval augmented generation
tasks.needs: academic paper search (arXiv, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex or Crossref)
tasks.must_return: paper titles with authors or links, at least one published in the last 12 months
tasks.fail_if: web search results without papers; empty list

tasks.task: What's the latest version of the Python package requests, and does it have known vulnerabilities?
tasks.needs: package registry metadata plus vulnerability lookup (PyPI and OSV)
tasks.must_return: the latest released version number and a vulnerability result (advisories list or 'none found') for that package
tasks.fail_if: npm package; version only with no vulnerability answer

tasks.task: Translate 'Where is the train station?' into Korean
tasks.needs: text translation between languages
tasks.must_return: a Korean sentence asking where the train station is (contains 역)
tasks.fail_if: language detection only; English output

tasks.task: Get the coordinates of the Eiffel Tower
tasks.needs: geocoding a place name or address to latitude and longitude
tasks.must_return: latitude about 48.858 and longitude about 2.294 (within 0.01)
tasks.fail_if: reverse geocoding only; another place

tasks.task: Are there any weather alerts in California right now?
tasks.needs: active US National Weather Service alerts by state
tasks.must_return: a list of active alerts with event names, or an explicit empty list with the time checked
tasks.fail_if: forecast without alerts; another state

tasks.task: What time is it in New York and in Seoul right now?
tasks.needs: current time or time-zone conversion for named places
tasks.must_return: current local times for both zones within 2 minutes of the real time
tasks.fail_if: UTC offset only without times; one zone only

tasks.task: When does the SSL certificate for example.com expire?
tasks.needs: TLS certificate inspection for a domain
tasks.must_return: the certificate's expiry date (and ideally issuer) for example.com
tasks.fail_if: domain registration expiry instead of the certificate

tasks.task: Find an API that gives me the transcript of a YouTube video
tasks.needs: YouTube transcript or captions for a video URL
tasks.must_return: timed or plain caption text for the video
tasks.fail_if: video metadata only; summary without transcript

tasks.task: Find an agent that converts PDF to text
tasks.needs: extract plain text from a PDF given by URL
tasks.must_return: plain text from the PDF that includes the phrase 'Attention Is All You Need'
tasks.fail_if: an error, an empty string, or only page metadata

tasks.task: Need a tool that returns current price of BTC in USD as JSON
tasks.needs: current cryptocurrency spot price
tasks.must_return: a numeric BTC price in USD with a timestamp within the last day
tasks.fail_if: a stock price; a price older than 7 days; a non-numeric value

tasks.task: Find an MCP server that can search GitHub repositories by keyword
tasks.needs: repository search on GitHub
tasks.must_return: a list of GitHub repositories with names or URLs matching the query
tasks.fail_if: issues or users only; an authentication error

tasks.task: Tool to fetch a web page and return clean markdown
tasks.needs: fetch a URL and return its main content as markdown or text
tasks.must_return: text containing 'Example Domain'
tasks.fail_if: raw HTML only; a screenshot; an error

tasks.task: Geocode a street address to latitude and longitude
tasks.needs: forward geocoding of an address
tasks.must_return: latitude about 38.89 and longitude about -77.03
tasks.fail_if: coordinates of another place; an empty result

tasks.task: Get the abstract of an arXiv paper by its id
tasks.needs: arXiv paper metadata lookup by identifier
tasks.must_return: the title 'Attention Is All You Need' and its abstract text
tasks.fail_if: search results without the requested paper

tasks.task: Look up a company's ticker symbol and latest stock quote
tasks.needs: stock quote by ticker
tasks.must_return: a numeric price for MSFT with a date within the last 7 days
tasks.fail_if: crypto prices; a quote older than 7 days

tasks.task: Find an agent that answers WHOIS for a domain
tasks.needs: domain WHOIS or RDAP registration lookup
tasks.must_return: registrar or registration dates for example.com
tasks.fail_if: DNS records only; an error

tasks.task: Need a tool to get npm package metadata (latest version)
tasks.needs: npm registry package lookup
tasks.must_return: the latest published version number of express
tasks.fail_if: a PyPI result; an error

tasks.task: Search Wikipedia and return the summary of an article
tasks.needs: Wikipedia article summary
tasks.must_return: a summary paragraph about Seoul from Wikipedia
tasks.fail_if: another article; an empty answer

tasks.task: Convert an amount between two currencies using a daily rate API
tasks.needs: fiat currency conversion with a dated rate
tasks.must_return: an EUR->JPY rate or converted amount with a date within the last 7 days
tasks.fail_if: crypto rates; no date

tasks.task: Get air quality index for a city
tasks.needs: current air quality measurements
tasks.must_return: an AQI value or pollutant concentrations for Delhi with a time within the last 2 days
tasks.fail_if: weather only; another city

tasks.task: Find a tool that validates JSON against a JSON Schema
tasks.needs: JSON Schema validation
tasks.must_return: a validation result reporting that property 'a' is missing
tasks.fail_if: a pass for the invalid instance; an error

tasks.task: Need an agent to list upcoming earthquakes data feed (USGS) above magnitude 5
tasks.needs: recent earthquake events from a seismic feed
tasks.must_return: a list of earthquakes with magnitude >= 5 and times within the last 30 days
tasks.fail_if: forecasts; events below magnitude 5 only

tasks.task: Resolve the IP address location (country, city) for an IP
tasks.needs: IP geolocation lookup
tasks.must_return: country 'United States' (or US) for 8.8.8.8
tasks.fail_if: DNS lookup only; an error
